nom: Murad City Skin Age Defense Broad Spectrum SPF 50 / PA++++

avis.texte: Love this mineral sunscreen! No white cast, and it feels like a really great moisturizer. I've used it every day for about three years, and I still haven't found one I like better.

I have dry and sensitive eczema prone skin. This is the only sunscreen that I can use on a daily basis without any skin irritation. There is also no noticeable white cast on my dark skin complexion which is a rare accomplishment for any mineral sunscreen. 10/10 recommend!

I have never written a review for a product before because even if I don't like something, I almost never care enough to review it, but given that this product is as expensive as it is it would almost be a disservice to the girls if I didnt speak up. I only got this sunscreen because I thought the other Murad sunscreen with vitamin C, which I love and would recommend even if it is a bit expensive, was discontinued. I got this one as a replacement. Disregarding the weird old carpet smell of the product, it's formula is so bizarre. It doesn't rub in, it leaves the white/grayish cast on the skin, and if you try to work it in, the product just starts peeling and rubbing off in little clumps. Its hard to describe. I also find that it just does not fully absorb into the skin it kind of sits on top and makes your skin texture look incredibly weird. This might not be too noticeable if you are someone of a lighter complexion, but as someone with darker skin, it just is not it for me. I do recognize that it's a mineral sunscreen and I know that these things can be hit or miss, however, the other Murad sunscreen with the vitamin C that I mentioned prior is also a mineral sunscreen doesn't do this. Given that this product costs a not insignificant amount of money, I'm disappointed. I can't return or exchange cause I've now been using it for several months, but I am fed up and just had to warn you guys. Steer clear! If you feel like you need to get a Murad sunscreen, then I recommend you

It's a beautiful finish, but it smells like feet. And it doesn't dissipate, unfortunately. I will use it up to walk my dog but I am very disappointed, especially at this price point. Will not repurchase.
No white cast omggg!!!! No matter how much you put on your face, it blends easily. Amazing and effective go to sunscreen.
I love it! Finally a sunscreen with Zinc oxide that doesn't leave a white cast. Also no scent. Buy it, you won't regret it.
My favorite sunscreen and hope they won't change the formula. Sill pricey for that small size but will definitely purchase it again!

This sunscreen is great other than the smell! My word it smells like old plastic and it lingers on your face all day! Other than that this sunscreen is pretty good, but sadly I need to return bc this is way too pricey to keep and not be able to wear.
Please dont ever change this formula!!! It gives the nicest glow and best primer under make up will be a forever purchaser!!!

I love this, it feels wonderful on the skin. My skin is soft after application, and the tint is perfect on my fair skin tone. I took off one star because of the price (standard 50 ml) & the fact that we don't know the percentage of vitamin C.

avis.titre: One of the better SPFs sold in the US
avis.texte: If you're spoiled by the elegant formulas and skin-friendly filters of Asian (Australian, or Euro) sunscreens, you know the struggle of finding a tolerable daily SPF in the States! Most chemical formulas burn and mineral formulas leave you looking coated in liquid zinc. I've tried heaps ($-$$$) and this Murad Sunscreen is one of the only American spfs that i dont mind having on my face/neck/décolletage. It's mineral, but with a slight tint that blends into my light olive skin with a nice glowy, radiant finish. I have sensitive combo skin with acne rosacea and this hasnt caused flares; however, i also have ocular rosacea which may be why it burns my eyes/orbital area. It doesn't sting my skin otherwise. I apply after my moisturizer, allow to dry, then use blotting papers to remove some of the ehhm…dew. Havent tried it under a full face but it sits nicely under concealer. While this Murad SPF is sweat and water resistant, like most mineral spfs it is not reapplication-friendly. Dab/pat on carefully to avoid pilling. Definitely heavier than its more elegant Asian counterparts, youre aware something is on your face and ready to wash it off when you get home (kinda feels like wearing a foundation or tinted moisturizer). But sun protection is effective and glow is nice.

Its pricey but its my absolutely favorite. I love putting it on in the morning. I'm under 30 but ive got dry skin, so i love how moisturizing and "dewy" this sunscreen is. If you have oily skin or dont like the "dewy" look… def dont go for this. Doesnt leave any white cast on me, however i am extremely pale. Main downside is that i have to he very careful about rubbing my eyes during the day. If you accidentally rub this stuff into your eye… it makes itself know. Regardless, 10/10 would recommend to anyone and everyone who can fit it into their budget and loves a dewy face.

Its pricey but its my absolutely favorite. I love putting it on in the morning. I'm under 30 but ive got dry skin, so i love how moisturizing and "dewy" this sunscreen is. If you have oily skin or dont like the "dewy" look… def dont go for this. Doesnt leave any white cast on me, however i am extremely pale. Main downside is that i have to he very careful about rubbing my eyes during the day. If you accidentally rub this stuff into your eye… it makes itself know. Regardless, 10/10 would recommend to anyone and everyone who can fit it into their budget and loves a dewy face.

avis.titre: Recommend if you have $$ to spare
avis.texte: I have really enjoyed this sunscreen, and it feels nice and doesnt leave a white cast. Does have a strong smell but its not offensive.

I absolutely love this sunscreen! I'm on my second tube of this because I love it so much. It provides great coverage. and is sensitive skin friendly. I have extremely sensitive skin and I'm always cautious trying out new products but this has been great! The product goes on smooth and is so easy to blend it. It doesn't have a sunscreen smell which is plus for me. I'm normally an oily person and haven't noticed feeling anymore oily or greasy. I normally do my skincare routine and this is my last step and I do mascara, blush, and lip gloss and love the glow that it gives my skin. Have also tried makeup over it and it works fine. Overall, I definitely recommend. It's definitely pricey, so that's my only con. I got it on sale and will continue to look for it to go on sale.

I really wanted to like this, but as soon as I applied it my skin started burning. My skin was also red even after I removed it. I made the switch to mineral spf bc some chemical spf's gave me the same reaction. I wasn't expecting a mineral sunscreen to do the same. I think I would like this product if my skin wasn't super sensitive. It was lightweight and had no white cast. If you have sensitive skin though I would definitely be cautious about this one.

Truly the best sunscreen I've tried. It's hard to find a mineral spf 50 that doesn't turn me into a grease ball, so this is such a refreshing and beautiful option. Expensive, yes. But honestly I'd rather spend my skincare budget on a good sunscreen than pretty much anything else. I appreciate the matte finish that doesn't dry out the skin. Not sticky, not dry, just… perfect.

I have used other mineral sunscreens, but Murad City Skin is the one I keep returning to. It's the best mineral sunscreen, unscented, just the right moisture, and with no white cast and yet with a tint so subtle I'm sure it matches any skin shade.
This is hands-down the best sunscreen I've ever used. It checks all the boxes. I have sensitive fair-light skin tone. The tint is perfect. I just love it.
This is the best sunscreen that I have ever tried. Definitely worth the price. Non-greasy and easy to apply.

avis.titre: Always a win with this brand
avis.texte: Murad is one of my fav brands dor akincare. This goes on so light, no cast, not sticky and not detectable under make up. It gives a really nice glow and is great for no make up days. 100% recommend!

This sunscreen is just incredible. I've used it for over a year. I'll try others here and there due to the price range of this one, but I always go back. It's truly worth every penny. Amazing formula, beautiful, effective, and completely mineral which is a must for my extremely sensitive eyes. No burning! From the formula... or the sun!!

avis.titre: It's pricey, but definitely worth the money!!!
avis.texte: As a brown skin girl, it's hard to find a physical sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast, but went out on a limb after reading some reviews. Folks, this is definitely worth the money! No white cast and moisturizing.

This sunscreen feels thick and heavy, I can tell that I have sunscreen on. The smell is awful and lasted for about 3 hours. It's not a sunscreen smell, it smells like someone with a cold sneezed in your face.
Looked horrible under makeup, made my skin dry. I returned it because it wasn't worth the money at all. I like Murad too but this isn't it. The new Tula gel one is so much better.
The best I've ever used!!! I spend all day in front of a monitor and this protects me a lot from blue light. I love it!

It took me years to find a sunscreen that I like. This is it! I've tried many other brands and they usually break me out, are too thick and leave a white cast, or just irritate my sensitive skin. I waited a few weeks before posting this to make sure I really liked it and I do, i enjoy it. It's a little pricey for me but it's totally worth it especially after wasting money on 100 other sunscreens. If you have sensitive, acne prone, red and dry skin… this might be the one for you too!
Great sunscreen. Doesn't break me out and no white cast. Lasts a long time as well. Love it.

I absolutely hate taking the time to leave reviews on products, but this one is so good I had to go out of my way to do it. There's nothing worse than slopping on layers and layers of product. This Doubles as my moisturizer and my sunscreen, which saves me from that cakey feeling. You can feel how high quality the ingredients are when you put it on. I switched from Elta MD which I have loved for years, and still think is a great product… but truth be told this is much better. Yes the price tag is a little steep if you are on a budget, but if you can splurge I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Unbelievable. I have finally found my love for sunscreen!
avis.texte: I'm one of those that has always dreaded putting sunscreen on. I'm 24 and really starting to protect my skin rather than just dressing it up as I've done for the past few years. This sunscreen is beautiful. I have neutral to warm toned fair/light skin, and this is the perfect completely sheer tint, no white cast, its truly invisible. It feels like a watered down, rich moisturizing makeup primer, while not being thick or greasy. I had an issue with chemical sunscreens irritating my skin, even darkening areas. I've been on the hunt for years for the perfect mineral sunscreen and this is really a complete product for me. It acts as a primer for my makeup, feels extremely light and also gives my skin a moisturizing glow. No shine, no greasy looks, no shimmer, just plump skin. I'm not a foundation girl. Light contour and lots of blush and this really is the perfect product for that. Creamy, rich and light, leaving plump, healthy skin. I never leave reviews. I just have to spread the happiness this product has given me!

I've been looking FOREVER for a sunscreen that doesn't break me out and finally found it with this one! It goes on super smooth, my makeup sits nicely over top, the tint complements my skin tone well, and even after wearing it all day, my skin doesn't break out. I only wish it wasn't so expensive!
The formulation of this product is great. Goes on skin smoothly and leaves a matte feel, not greasy at all. Slight sheer tint that is truly sheer and doesn't show any white residue.
I apply this after my morning shower before I sit down to my laptop. Later in the day, I reapply it to protect my skin from UVA/UVB rays from the sun.

I have a reaction to most chemical sunscreen so use mineral ones. This is the best I've ever tried. I've tried others (this one's expensive) but they end up being thin and heavy on my skin or too drying. This one is perfect under or over make-up.
It's so strong smelling and it does not fade. Not fragrance scent but like mechanic grease.
Feels great, works well. Not sure I'll buy again due to price but I did like it

Love this Murad product - I have purchased and used for many years. I think it is excellent for protecting your skin from the sun plus with the beneficial ingredients, it keeps my skin looking good. I apply with a brush every morning. It goes on beautifully this way, never leaves a white cast, absorbs into the skin, and never feels heavy or greasy. I use it 365 days a year!
I love it. It's hydrating for the rest of the year, except for winter time. It looks great under makeup.

I love this sunscreen and it had moved to the top of my favorites list. There is no ash or white residue - just a clean sunscreen that provides excellent coverage. I can see the sunscreen as I apply so it allows me to ensure full coverage and then immediately melts into my skin. There is no pilling and that's an additional plus.
It's a light weight sunscreen that doesn't leave any white cast. I use it under my foundation and it makes my make up look smoother and stay longer. Wonderful product!

This is a great sunscreen; I suffered from horrible melasma and need daily protection. This one is good... lightweight and easy on my skin; not greasy/not drying just right. I love this product... but not the price! Will repurchase for sure.

One of the few products with high SPF that doesn't cause my skin to negatively react. I use a generous nickel-sized amount (that's how much you need to get the full sun protection advertised) and it soaks into the skin quickly and while I'm shiny after, it's not super greasy feeling. With a couple of my eye products, I notice pilling, so I'm careful to apply the SPF first and then other products on top. Works great!

I will be using this product every day! It's like a primer and makes my foundation look better. I love the very slight tint and slight glow it gives without looking or feeling at all greasy. I love the high protection level this gives my skin. It doesn't break me out like some other products do, and it doesn't seem to irritate my very sensitive eyes if I get it a little close to them. I am very, very picky when it comes to product. I never even knew this existed until I received a sample in a free gift with purchase. Though pricey, I'm willing to pay money for excellent product. So glad I discovered this!

I use this daily under my makeup. It's the only sunscreen I know of that uses physical UV barriers without turning me ghost white. It also doesn't make me break out! It leaves my skin soft and is a great base to my bb cream.

I've been using this sunscreen for 2 years now. It is pricey-but it's the only one that works for my skin. Lasts me about 6 months depending on how often I need to use it (Im a home body). I have oily, acne-prone sensitive skin and hate the feeling of sunscreen on my face/the white cast some leave. this feels light, I usually use it in place of a moisturizer. It doesn't make me look like a greasy mess, but still allows me to have a healthy appearance without mattifying all my glow. Ingredients are a plus, as I can only use mineral based sunscreens (for the oceans, and my sensitive skin). The only downside is it doesn't wear the best under liquid foundation (still workable though just minor separation/creasing after a few hours) but I don't wear foundation that often anyway. Best sunscreen! (a cheap fav that reminds me of this is the Maelove one, it's a bit more matte and sort of tacky though!)

avis.titre: This is a product I buy repeatedly.
avis.texte: This is my favorite sunscreen. I have temperamental skin that tends to break out easily. Not only does this not break me out but I can reapply on top of it without having it clog my pores. The slight pigment to it is just enough for days that I am not going to put on sunscreen.

avis.titre: HG Sun protection! But possibly discontinued?!?!
avis.texte: This is the absolute BEST sun protection product out there that I have tried. If you follow Paula Begoun, she also highly rated this product over her own, and she was right. I've been buying these up when I see these at Ulta because it appears Murad is discontinuing it! I have no idea what I will do without it. I sure hope Murad does not discontinue such a wonderful product. It's not heavy, no white cast, it has a light tint to it, sinks in lovely, nice sheen and glow, great ingredients, high protection. I receive so many compliments on my skin. Please don't stop making this, Murad!

avis.titre: Pry from my cold dead hands
avis.texte: I have fair, sensitive, dry skin with rosacea and I'm in my 30s. My dermatologist "approved" this product because it's all physical blocking so it's perfect for my skin type. I love this stuff. When you're applying the 1/4 tsp recommended amount for ALL sunscreens, I do find that this one tends to be a little greasier than others. If you have oily skin, I don't think you would care for this product. Normal to very dry- it's gonna be your HG. I use it as a primer under my makeup and when I'm going bare-faced. Probably my favorite part about this stuff is the viscosity- it's very liquidy- more than a typical lotion, which I find terrific for coverage and lack of "skip spots." Oh- and My husband uses this sunscreen, too! Both of us each have a bottle and we go through it every couple of months. Cons: -Not ideal for POC -Not ideal for oily skin -Can get two reapplications of this, but a third is just too greasy
this is my go to sunscreen. i used a sample and fell in love. it is pricy but i use it on my daughter too and this doesnt irritate her skin. would keep repurchasing

avis.titre: Will only buy this again and again
avis.texte: My friend recommended it and it makes my skin have a glowy finish. I get compliments on my skin appearance. My sister is using it too and it works great if blended with my foundation. It's pricey but I love it.

Does not feel like sunscreen at all, feels like a high end primer or thin moisturizer. Smell is very light and nice. The tint is hardly visible but I feel confident enough to go without foundation almost all the time now. I'm a new mom and most days I don't have time for sun protection and makeup- with this I can skip the makeup and I feel like a million bucks while knowing my skin is being protected from damage. Game changer, worth the price!
Amazing, game changing physical sunblock. Non-drying as last step over skincare; nearly like a primer under foundation. No white cast and no uncomfortable stickiness. So grateful for this product!!

I like the tint on this product because it does not feel like foundation. Although, I do not think this will work well with darker skin tones. It does not leave a cast. It has a nice sheen to it despite feeling dry. Biggest problem is that it's easy to sweat it off- thus leaving you vulnerable. Additionally, it makes moisturizers peel off (or it peels off itself) when being applied. It is very lightweight. For the price I would expect that this formula would work well with different moisturizers- especially as it is VERY drying. I would recommend only for individuals who could use a bit of dryness.

The tint is very fair. I have pale-medium skin and I noticed this does seem to wash me out just a tiny bit. This is preferable to looking orange everyday, but this probably wouldn't work for anyone with skin thats on the lighter side of medium and darker. At first it did seem to irritate my skin, but my skin has since gotten used to it. I would say the UV protection works fairly well, as I haven't gotten a burn. I like how light it feels. Other sunscreens I've used have felt grainy or clogged my pores, whereas this one does not. However, ever since I started using it, I've noticed my eyeliner runs, which NEVER happened before. I'm not sure what exactly would cause that, but it seems related to the sunscreen. The tint also offers no coverage. That's not what this product is for, but I assumed it would offer a tiny bit just based on other tinted sunscreens I've used.

I live in Southern California so I know it's especially important for me to wear spf due to the constant sun exposure but I never was able to find a sunscreen that didn't irritate my skin and make me break out all over. I saw this and was like wow that's expensive. But the ingredients are great and I took a chance on it and let me say it's phenomenal. It's thinner than a lotion but thicker than a liquid , and is very hydrating which is great for my dry sensitive skin. I can layer it over my skincare with no pilling and I can layer my makeup on top and it looks great as a base. If you have tried many sunscreens and have had no luck I strongly suggest you give this one a chance. In my opinion it's worth every penny.

I live in Southern California so I know it's especially important for me to wear spf due to the constant sun exposure but I never was able to find a sunscreen that didn't irritate my skin and make me break out all over. I saw this and was like wow that's expensive. But the ingredients are great and I took a chance on it and let me say it's phenomenal. It's thinner than a lotion but thicker than a liquid , and is very hydrating which is great for my dry sensitive skin. I can layer it over my skincare with no pilling and I can layer my makeup on top and it looks great as a base. If you have tried many sunscreens and have had no luck I strongly suggest you give this one a chance. In my opinion it's worth every penny.

avis.titre: Excellent coverage and feels light on skin
avis.texte: I wear this over my day moisturizer, and it's very light and non-greasy. Sometimes I pick up a faint smell of sunscreen. I do wish there was a fragrance in this sunscreen since that might take away some of the "sunscreen" smell.

I received a sample of this from ulta and thank goodness it's only a sample so I don't have to return it. No it's not 'scented' but it does smell. It reminds of a hospital. The scent hasn't gone away and I'm not a fan of having something smelly on my face where I cannot escape it and didn't have time to start my face routine over again. My fault for not smelling it first. It's just yuck! Smell it before you buy it!!!!!

This sunscreen is phenomenal! I'm really picky about what I allow on my skin due to suffering from bad acne and this stuff definitely made the cut. I apply a thin layer all over my face, neck and chest daily and it doesn't clog my pores or feel greasy at all. Yeah it is a little pricey, but it does last a while considering how little you need to cover up your face.
Yes, crazy expensive for all that you should use daily but not too shiny and goes on pretty much clear so it makes me willing to use it every day.

I put a layer on my face and chest and then 15 minutes later put another layer on before going to the dog park. 70 minutes at the dog park and I am so burnt. My chest is EXTREMELY burnt. Very disappointed. I try very hard to take care of my skin. It feels lovely on the skin but I would not recommend for sun protection.

Love this sunscreen for my everyday face protection! It rubs in easily, gives a radiant glow and I have not had any new sun damage since using it! It also does not clog my pores so I haven't had any issues with breakout which is something I typically experience with sunscreen on my face. The only negative thing I have to say is it isn't waterproof or sweatproof so if your going in water or plan on being active then you might need some additional protection.

avis.titre: I love this product with this product! Excellent protection,
avis.texte: I love this product with this product! Excellent protection, light and helps improve skin pigmentation.
This is the best facial sunscreen I've found. It's not sticky or greasy or drying. It's a little expensive but well worth it in my opinion. Hopefully it lasts a while!

I love this sunscreen. It is the best I've tried so far. My face feels very smooth after I apply it. It doesn't burn the eyes. And I feel like it gives me a nice glow. I will probably continue to buy this product, it will be my splurge.

I combine it with Australian Gold tinted mineral sof 50 with a small pump of foundation. This cocktail saves me time, it actually looks like I have primer on blurring pores, and just enough color that I don't need another layer of foundation. Sometimes I don't add foundation, as bronzer takes care of more color as needed. I love the PA in it for added protection. I apply my cocktail to include my neck. This is my second bottle-- on standby, for when I finish my first one, which I bought in August. I purchase when i can get 20%off, saving $13 each time, bc let's face it, it's expensive. I'm a budget buyer on makeup, but I spend more on quality skin products, including Paula's Choice. Sun protection is essential, every day!

Love this sunblock, it works well with and without makeup, doesn't dry out my skin nor leave a white cast. I like that it has an SPF higher than 30 and doesn't cause any stinging nor irritation. So far I haven't encountered any negatives. I haven't used it with liquid foundation, only powder foundation, but it works well over my moisturizer, with my primer, concealer etc.

I was on the market for new daily sunscreen with high SPF since I started acne treatment. I used to use Clinique City Block, but it always felt so thick on my skin and would cause my pores to clog and me to get oily. A store associate recommended this and I fell in love after two days of using it. It is so thin and goes on so smoothly! It doesn't cause my skin to get oily and it has great all day protection. I don't think I will ever change so please never stop making this Murad!

I've tried so many different mineral sunscreen, from drug store brands to luxury brands, and finally settled with this one. I avoided going for this sunscreen so many time due to the price, but I can't find anything else like it. It's not drying to the skin, not sticky or greasy, doesn't irritate, or leave an obvious horrible tint on the skin. After applying the sunscreen it doesn't take long for it to dry down and leaves your skin fresh and healthy looking. It doesn't leave your skin completely matte nor does it leave your skin shiny and gross at the end of the day. Another nice thing is that the tint is not enough to stain your shirts or anything you might rub your face against, an issue I've had with a lot of tinted physical sunscreens. I love it, I just wish it wasn't so expensive!
great under makeup! doesn't give you that "white" masky look.

avis.titre: Never leave home without putting this on first
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer! I'm a Murad girl and this is by far the best one I've used. It leaves your skin with a nice subtle glow. I put it on after the Invisiblur, no foundation and it looks flawless.

avis.titre: Did Not Work for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: Disclaimer: I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin to SPF, so I'm not sure if I should give this such a low rating, because it's probably just me, not the product. I have yet to find an SPF that does not cause my skin to start itching and to develop a rash, and this was no exception. If I had normal skin, I would've liked this SPF - it didn't smell bad, it went on smoothly, it was easy to dispense....but it unfortunately made my skin very itchy and splotchy.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen out there, hands down!!!!!
avis.texte: I've been researching sunscreen ingredients lately because there are so many out there and I didn't know which ones were harmful. It seems mineral sunscreens are much safer for everyday use but usually are greasy and leave white residue all over your face. This mineral sunscreen is the sheerest I've ever used. It goes on like silk and completely disappears in a minute or two at most. No greasy feel, no white residue. I don't know how they did it, but this mineral sunscreen surpasses all the others. I don't care if it's a little more expensive because the product is so worth it in the long run. You will not regret buying this product. I actually want to put on sunscreen everyday now. Thank you Murad!

This is such a nice light sunscreen. Didn't clog my pores, went seamlessly under makeup, and didn't leave a white cast. My one complaint is that I definitely got oily a lot faster than without. I have combination skin and my oily areas are VERY oily. So if you have normal or dry skin you probably wouldn't experience that. Definitely worth a try.
